notes: This invoice bundles 3 separate real Faktur Pajak, each embedded in the same PDF as invoice_3 (not a separate FP document) — one per line item: Admin Fee (fp 04002600279925528, taxable 20,000.00, vat 2,200.00), Water (fp 08002600279925080, taxable 277,390.00, vat 30,513.00), Electricity (fp 08002600279925110, taxable 4,741,120.00, vat 521,523.00).
